title: GLHS R4 Phase 0 / E18: Global Source Support vs. Disclosed Support Separation Protocol
phase: Phase 0 — Prospective Experimental & Statistical Plan for R4
scientific_unit: logical schedule with evidence present in DB but excluded from prompt disclosure

primary_endpoints.name: C4 Omission Detection and Rejection Rate
primary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of proposals asserting valid database evidence omitted from prompt projection that are rejected by C4 (FULL_GRWC).

secondary_endpoints.name: C1 Omission Detection Rate
secondary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of proposals asserting valid database evidence omitted from prompt projection detected by C1 (OCC_READSET).

secondary_endpoints.name: Rejection Reason Code Concordance
secondary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of C4 rejections returning designated code proposal_evidence_not_disclosed.

secondary_endpoints.name: Disclosed Control Schedule Admission Rate
secondary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of fully disclosed control proposals successfully committed by C4.

sample_size.unit_definition: 200 logical schedules (100 schedules where evidence is present in PostgreSQL but omitted from prompt projection + 100 fully disclosed control schedules)

statistical_plan.method: Exact Binomial Tests and McNemar Concordance Analysis for Omitted Evidence Rejection

stopping_rules.fail_closed_criteria: Halt immediately if C4 admits any proposal containing undisclosed evidence (Gate 3 failure).
stopping_rules.missing_data_rule: Unprocessed or dropped schedule executions are treated as fail-closed audit anomalies.
